mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `camera_device`
device_id, plot_id, name, stream_protocol, stream_url, snapshot_url, resolution, online_status, direction,
#{deviceId}, #{plotId}, #{name}, #{streamProtocol}, #{streamUrl}, #{snapshotUrl}, #{resolution}, #{onlineStatus}, #{direction},
mapper.sql: c.id, c.device_id, c.plot_id, p.plot_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cr.crop_name), ''), '暂无作物') AS crop_name, c.name AS camera_name, c.stream_protocol, c.stream_url, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.snapshot_url), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(ccr.image_url), '')) AS snapshot_url, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.snapshot_url), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(ccr.image_url), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.crop_image), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pb.crop_image), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(cr.image_url), '')) AS cover_url, c.resolution, c.online_status, c.direction

JOIN `plot` p ON p.id = c.plot_id LEFT JOIN `planting_batch` pb ON pb.id = ( SELECT pb2.id FROM `planting_batch` pb2 WHERE pb2.plot_id = p.id AND pb2.status = 1 ORDER BY pb2.planted_at DESC, pb2.create_time DESC, pb2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN `crop` cr ON cr.id = pb.crop_id LEFT JOIN `camera_capture_record` ccr ON ccr.id = ( SELECT ccr2.id FROM `camera_capture_record` ccr2 WHERE ccr2.device_id = c.id AND ccr2.status = 1 ORDER BY ccr2.capture_time DESC, ccr2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `camera_capture_plan` WHERE device_id = #{cameraId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `camera_capture_record` WHERE device_id = #{cameraId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `ai_recognition_result` ar JOIN `ai_recognition_record` rr ON rr.id = ar.record_id WHERE rr.camera_id = #{cameraId})
